pubhealth.note: PUBHEALTH (Kotonya & Toni, EMNLP 2020). The 'health_fact' and ImperialCollegeLondon/health_fact ids are script-based and fail on datasets>=4.0; this is a parquet conversion. 4-way labels reduced to binary by dropping mixture/unproven.

_unrecoverable.gossip: GossipCop (FakeNewsNet, Shu et al.). Real in only 10/40 runs; the local gossipcop.csv is gone. Candidate mirrors exist but none is the same corpus: LittleFish-Coder/Fake_News_GossipCop ships ~800MB of precomputed embeddings and stalls; Jinyan1/GossipCop splits are MF/HF/MR/HR (machine- vs human-generated), i.e. a machine-text-detection variant, NOT the original fake/real corpus. Substituting it would silently change what the dataset measures — needs a decision.
_unrecoverable.snopes: CSV-only, no source documented anywhere in the repo. Real in 10/38 runs; the CSV that produced those is gone. No public HF mirror found.
_unrecoverable.weather: Truth-discovery style tabular dataset. NEVER real (0/51 runs). No source documented.
_unrecoverable.population: Truth-discovery style tabular dataset. NEVER real (0/46 runs). No source documented.
_unrecoverable.flights: Truth-discovery style tabular dataset. NEVER real (0/44 runs). No source documented. The classic Flight benchmark (Li et al., VLDB 2013) is a candidate replacement but is a DIFFERENT dataset and needs an explicit decision.
